Bill.BriefDescription: Providing for a JLARC study of the basic health plan.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the basic health plan; creating a new section;and making an appropriation.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The joint legislative audit and reviewcommittee shall conduct a study of the basic health plan. Part 1 ofthe study shall examine the extent to which basic health plan policiesand procedures promote or discourage the provision of appropriate,high-quality, cost-effective care to basic health plan enrollees.Issues to be addressed include, but are not limited to, whether: (a)Enrollees are encouraged to engage in wellness activities and receivepreventive services; (b) evidence-based treatment strategies areidentified and promoted; (c) enrollees are encouraged to use highquality providers; (d) enrollees with chronic or other high-costconditions are identified and provided with appropriate interventions;and (e) innovative health care service delivery methods are encouraged.Part 1 of the study report must be completed by December 15, 2005. (2) Part 2 of the study must examine the characteristics ofindividuals enrolled in the basic health plan, and their utilization ofhealth care services, including but not limited to: (a) Enrollee p. 1 SB 5536longevity on the basic health plan; (b) circumstances that led to basichealth plan enrollment; (c) how enrollees obtained health care prior tobasic health plan enrollment; (d) health care coverage of otherhousehold members; and (e) service utilization patterns. A part 2interim report must be completed by December 15, 2005, and the finalreport completed by July 1, 2006.

The sum of one hundred thousand dollars, oras much thereof as may be necessary, is appropriated from the generalfund to the joint legislative audit and review committee for the fiscalyear ending June 30, 2006, to carry out the purposes of this act.
